verdict.rationale: DBOS documents a workflow fork operation that restarts a workflow from a completed step, using checkpointed state to reproduce it deterministically for debugging. The Conductor dashboard can restart any workflow from a specific step, and fork is also exposed through the Conductor HTTP API and dbosctl, while recorded step checkpoints can be reviewed to audit the failure. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that fork/replay works as described.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I replay or rerun a failed workflow from its recorded history — optionally from a specific step — to debug and recover

citations.quote: Fork restarts a workflow from a completed step, using checkpointed information to deterministically reproduce the state of the workflow up to that step.
